dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I am considering whether to fetch my outstanding paperwork, so that I can look through it during our downtime...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: In that case, I'll brew some coffee. I'll make one for you, too.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: #Hm. You look troubled, {NICKNAME}. Are you worried about the enemies we will soon face?

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I see... Sorry, I should have noticed sooner. You asked me to join your team — it is only right that I share this burden with you.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: The Dandelion Knight's sword is at your command. Let us proceed.

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I wonder if that novel I read once is available to borrow here...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Not that I was especially fond of it. I just didn't finish reading it, so I've always wondered what happens after where I left off...

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: I really hope it has a happy ending.
